title: Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification for Weather Forecasting: Conformal Prediction Under Spatiotemporal Dependence
abstract: arXiv:2611.24329v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conformal prediction gives finite-sample, distribution-free marginal coverage and has begun to be applied to gridded weather forecasts. Marginal coverage concerns the long-run fraction of covered points at a location, not how coverage behaves jointly across space and time on a given day. I benchmark eight interval-construction procedures (Gaussian, pooled and per-cell split conformal, per-season, adaptive conformal inference and rolling windows) for gridded 2 m temperature forecasts at eight lead times from 6 hours to 10 days, using ERA5 at 5.625 degree resolution, a deliberately modest convolutional forecaster and ECMWF's operational HRES, with calibration in 2017-2018 and testing in 2019-2021. Alongside coverage, width and interval score, I report dependence diagnostics: a spatial overdispersion index, quantiles of daily spatial coverage and miss persistence relative to a shuffled-days null. Per-cell methods reach near-nominal marginal

translated_title: 天气预报的无分布不确定性量化：时空依赖下的共形预测
translated_abstract: 共形预测能够提供有限样本、无分布的边际覆盖率保证，并已开始被应用于网格化天气预报。然而，边际覆盖率关注的是单个点位上长期被覆盖的比例，而非在某一天内覆盖率在空间与时间上的联合表现。我对八种区间构造方法（高斯方法、池化拆分共形、逐格点拆分共形、逐季节方法、自适应共形推断和滚动窗口）进行了基准测试，研究对象是网格化的2米气温预报，涵盖从6小时到10天共八个预报时效，使用5.625度分辨率的ERA5数据、一个刻意保持简洁的卷积预报模型以及ECMWF的业务化HRES模式，其中2017-2018年用于校准，2019-2021年用于测试。除覆盖率、区间宽度和区间得分外，我还报告了依赖性诊断指标：空间过散度指数、每日空间覆盖率的分位数，以及相对于日期随机打乱零假设的漏报持续性。逐格点方法达到了接近名义水平的边际覆盖率……
tldr: 该论文对八种共形预测区间构造方法在网格化2米气温预报（6小时至10天八个时效）中的表现进行了系统基准测试，并创新性地引入空间过散度指数、每日空间覆盖率分位数和漏报持续性等时空依赖性诊断指标，揭示了边际覆盖率与时空联合覆盖表现之间的差异。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks eight conformal interval-construction procedures for gridded 2m temperature forecasts across eight lead times (6 hours to 10 days), and introduces novel spatiotemporal dependence diagnostics—spatial overdispersion index, daily spatial coverage quantiles, and miss persistence—revealing how marginal coverage differs from joint coverage across space and time.
